note: Rewritten from Krishna 1962; original in English; in table 1 the hyphen of the postmentum length row was swallowed by the OCR (0,940.96) and is recorded here as 0.94—0.96; the other measurements are transcribed verbatim.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is closest to C. snyderi: the latter has a wider head, a frons that is more than vertical in side view, a deeper U-shaped notch between the frontal lobes, and a small swelling at the outer base of the mandibles. C. emarginicollis is much larger in all measurements, with a deeper and wider notch between the frontal lobes; C. nearcticus has a wider head and a broad shallow V-shaped notch between the lobes; C. parvinotus is much smaller in all measurements, with a shallower notch between the lobes. In this species the notch between the frontal lobes is a deep V, and the outer margin of the mandibles is nearly straight.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, blackish anteriorly; mandibles and pronotum brown; mesonotum and metanotum light brown; antennae yellowish brown; forelegs yellowish brown, mid and hind legs pale yellow; abdominal sternites greyish white to yellowish brown. Head with a few scattered setae; pronotum with setae along the margins and on the disc. Sides of the head parallel, in a few specimens very weakly narrowed anteriorly; frons bilobed, with a deep V-shaped notch between the lobes; in side view the top of the frons is vertical, the middle inclined at about 75°, the dorsum concave; an angular projection of the gena lies between the base of the mandibles and below the antennal socket. Mandibles short, the outer margin nearly straight; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, teeth 1 and 2 close together, the cutting edge concave between teeth 2 and 3; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the tip of the first marginal tooth 0.21 mm from the tip of the apical tooth. Shape of the postmentum as figured, contraction index 0.73—0.82. Antennae 11—12-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 4; with 11 segments segment 3 is shorter than segment 2 or segment 4, with 12 segments segment 3 equals segment 4. Pronotum slightly wider than the head, anterior margin concave, posterior margin notched, posterior lateral margins rounded or nearly straight. Measurements (mm, holotype / range of 4 heads / mean): head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 1.58 / 1.54—1.58 / 1.57; head width 1.16 / 1.13—1.20 / 1.17; head height 1.13 / 1.13 / 1.13; left mandible length 0.60 / 0.60—0.62 / 0.60; postmentum maximum width 0.39 / 0.39—0.41 / 0.41; postmentum minimum width 0.32 / 0.30—0.32 / 0.32; postmentum length 0.94 / 0.94—0.96 / 0.95; pronotum median length 0.47 / 0.43—0.47 / 0.46; pronotum maximum length 0.69 / 0.66—0.69 / 0.68; pronotum width 1.20 / 1.20—1.22 / 1.20; hind tibia length 0.60 / 0.60—0.62 / 0.61.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate unknown. Type locality: above El Naranjo, San Luis Potosí, Mexico (22°10′ N, 101°00′ W), collected by R. M. Cole on 1942-08-01 (no. 11A), holotype and paratype soldiers and nymphs. The species is named after R. M. Cole. In table 1 of the original the postmentum length row reads "0,940.96", recorded here as 0.94—0.96.
